differential.name: Fibromyalgia
differential.rationale: Diffuse chronic musculoskeletal pain with associated fatigue and stress in a young adult with multiple pain sites.

differential.name: Chronic mechanical low back pain
differential.rationale: Persistent low back pain likely related to occupational strain and poor ergonomics, common in individuals with limited access to care.

differential.name: Major depressive disorder
differential.rationale: Chronic pain, stress, intimate partner abuse, and socioeconomic hardship increase risk for depression presenting with somatic complaints.

differential.name: Post‑traumatic stress disorder
differential.rationale: History of intimate partner violence and environmental violence can manifest as chronic pain and heightened stress response.

differential.name: Somatic symptom disorder
differential.rationale: Excessive focus on physical symptoms (neck and back pain) disproportionate to any identifiable pathology, often linked to psychosocial stressors.
